description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink messaging in a Linux environment, including message parameter construction, frame parsing, and socket communication abstractions within the WPEFramework core namespace.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class for Netlink message handling, providing serialization, deserialization, and common properties for Netlink messages.

classes.name: Netlink::Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Netlink::Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over and validating Netlink message frames within a received data buffer.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific Netlink connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message ingestion.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class encapsulating a Linux Netlink socket, supporting message sending, receiving, and asynchronous event handling.

methods.name: Parameters
methods.description: Constructor for initializing message parameters with a header and buffer.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the constructed message.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new attribute to the message with a specified type and value.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current frame is valid.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next frame in the buffer.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the message type.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the message.

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Returns the message flags.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message data.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the message data.

methods.name: RawData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw message data.

methods.name: RawSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the raw message data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink message.

methods.name: Acknowledge
methods.description: Returns acknowledgment status for connector messages.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests a stream of bytes as a Netlink connector message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the message into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a message from a byte stream.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for a response.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes received data into a Netlink message.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket buffer.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket buffer.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes.
